 UMass vs. Akron prediction
 UMass could reach six wins for the first time since joining the FBS, but quarterback health is a concern. William "Pop" Watson III suffered a lower-body injury on the third offensive play against Toledo last week. Logan Inagawa replaced him and produced 99 passing yards with another 40 on the ground. UMass finished with 188 yards of offense in a 24-0 defeat.
 Akron quarterback Cibastian Broughton has completed 73.7% of his passes across five appearances this season, throwing six touchdown passes against one interception. He connected twice with Marcel Williams for touchdowns against Western Michigan last Tuesday. Williams finished with 85 receiving yards. UMass cornerback Isaiah Reed ranks second in the MAC with 1.11 passes defended per game, and Massachusetts has collected 13 takeaways this season.
 Akron allows 201.2 rushing yards per game, presenting an opportunity for UMass running back Curtis Kimmons IV, who's amassed a team-high 426 rushing yards. Opponents average 5.9 yards per carry against Akron, which has lost eight consecutive games. Kalshi lists a UMass victory by four or more points at $0.49 Yes and $0.52 No. SportsLine anticipates a 31-19 UMass victory, with Massachusetts winning 74% of simulations.  Trade $25 and get a $55 bonus here with the best Kalshi promo code CBSSPORTS55 : 
 Buffalo vs. Central Michigan prediction
 Buffalo won last week's game against Ball State with just 48 passing yards. Running back Messiah Burch delivered a career-high 209 rushing yards and scored twice in the 28-7 victory. Terrance Shelton Jr. added 92 yards on 10 carries. Burch leads the MAC with 1,110 rushing yards this season, and Buffalo receiver Chance Morrow is one touchdown reception shy of reaching double digits.
 Central Michigan has found a groove offensively under head coach Matt Drinkall after losing three consecutive conference games. Nick Woodford and Jayden Clerveaux rushed for 119 and 100 yards, respectively, against Sacramento State last week. Quarterback Jadyn Glasser completed 11 of 19 passes, including a 52-yard connection with Nasir Williams. Central Michigan has converted 21 of 30 fourth-down attempts this season, setting a program record for conversions.
 Central Michigan defeated Buffalo 38-19 last November and needs one more victory to become bowl eligible. Buffalo's defense allows 158.3 rushing yards per game, while its offense averages 24.3 points.
